syllabus_topics: Instruction Set Architecture: types of operands and operations in a processor; memory map; interface with peripherals; handling of interrupts/exceptions.
Processor operation: data paths; control structures; single-cycle and pipelined architectures.
Memory hierarchy: structure and operation of cache memories; hierarchical memory structures; physical and virtual addressing and address translation.
assessment_rules: The individual assessment for the course is determined by the formula: NF = 0.25L + 0.375 x Max(T1,ERp1) + 0.375 x Max(T2,ERp2). For approval, the final grade (NF) must not be lower than 9.5 values. For the special examination period, the final grade (NF) is determined solely by the special examination (EE). An oral evaluation test may be scheduled if discrepancies occur between theoretical and laboratory component grades, at the discretion of the course instructor.
bibliography: David A. Patterson, John L. Hennessy, Computer Organization and Design: the Hardware/Software Interface, 5th Edition, Morgan Kaufmann, 2013 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEEC21 Eng. Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura Bolonha em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC21)
